overview: 141 official Qs (2008, 2017, 2019, 2025). BoP and foreign trade lead (26, 11 of them in 2025), then banking structure (17), monetary policy (13) and tax structure (11). Mostly one-liners (70 + 41 without printed options), 17 negative items, a few statement, two-statement, matching and A-R items in 2025. Facts asked: which tool/body does what, deficit definitions, committee chairs, dated rates and ratios, what GST excludes, BoP components.

possibility.angle: Money – functions, measures (M0/M1/M3, L1-L3), money creation, seigniorage, crypto
possibility.what_they_ask: components of reserve/high-powered money, what L1-L3 are called, who creates money, seigniorage, demonetisation paradox
notes RBI does not issue (Re 1), lender of last resort, BR Act 1949 powers, Act used for demonetisation, Governor in office, FICN

possibility.angle: Monetary policy – MPC, inflation target, repo/SDF/MSF/LAF, I-CRR, committees
possibility.what_they_ask: who fixes repo, target 4% ±2, repo vs reverse repo direction, SDF needs no collateral, MSF as ceiling, Urjit Patel/Chakravarty committees, matching policy to instrument

possibility.angle: Control of credit – CRR/SLR and selective controls
possibility.what_they_ask: direction of effect of a CRR cut; SLR value in a given review

possibility.angle: Banking structure – commercial, RRB, DFIs, NABARD, money vs capital market, NBFCs
possibility.what_they_ask: which is a DFI/term lender, organised vs unorganised money market members, gilt-edged meaning, ARDC→NABARD 1982, RRB committee, SENSEX, P2P, shadow lenders

possibility.angle: Development of banking – nationalisation, Lead Bank, financial inclusion, Andhra Bank
possibility.what_they_ask: 1969 deposit threshold, Lead Bank origin, PMJDY aim, founder of Andhra Bank

possibility.angle: Banking reforms – committees, base rate, PCA, CRAR, IBC, mergers, scams
possibility.what_they_ask: committee for IRDA (Malhotra) or financial inclusion (Rangarajan), base-rate definition, what PCA/CRAR check, IBC year, 2019 merger partner
core vs headline, who loses from inflation, stagflation factors, deflator vs purchasing power, combined policy remedy, Bharat Rice price

possibility.angle: Fiscal policy – deficits, debt, deficit finance, FRBM and N.K. Singh review
possibility.what_they_ask: definition of fiscal/primary deficit, debt trap, internal debt components, what FRBM does not provide (penalties), N.K. Singh 2.5% target, RD target dropped 2018

possibility.angle: Indian tax structure – direct/indirect, committees, incidence, Laffer, MODVAT
possibility.what_they_ask: what is not a tax (SAT), excise base (production), committee for agricultural tax (Raj 1972), ad valorem meaning, angel tax year, states' largest tax

possibility.angle: GST – Council, subsumed and excluded items, GSTN, rollout
possibility.what_they_ask: Article of the Council (279A), items with no GST, last state to join (J&K), nature of GSTN

possibility.angle: Recent Union Budget – receipts/expenditure classes, deficits, budget practices, schemes
possibility.what_they_ask: revenue vs capital expenditure, biggest capital receipt, development vs non-development, FD RE/BE numbers, ZBB, Purvodaya, 11 a.m. presentation

possibility.angle: Balance of payments and foreign trade – accounts, invisibles, exchange rates, devaluation, WTO, FER
possibility.what_they_ask: BoP scope, source of net invisibles, FER components, SDR nature, direct vs indirect quote, devaluation effect, WTO agreements/boxes, entrepot and intra-industry trade
banned sector (chit funds), MBRT cap 51%, top FDI sector, Survey FDI trend, FPI facts

traps.trap: [Direction] Reverses who lends to whom or which way a tool moves liquidity
traps.spot: Repo/reverse repo, SDF/MSF, CRR up/down in options
traps.fix: Repo = RBI lends (inject); reverse repo/SDF = RBI absorbs; CRR cut → more credit
traps.pyq: Repo = 'RBI lends money to the commercial banks' [prelims-2019#122]; SDF absorbs liquidity without collateral [mains-2025-paper2#15]

traps.trap: [Deficits] Swaps one deficit definition for another
traps.spot: Options describe RD, FD, PD and debt stock
traps.fix: RD = rev exp – rev rec; FD = total borrowing; PD = FD – interest
traps.pyq: Primary deficit = 'Fiscal deficit less interest payments' [mains-2017-paper3#20]; FD closest to 'interest bearing borrowings during a year' [prelims-2017#100]

traps.trap: [Body] Gives a power to the wrong authority
traps.spot: Options mix Finance Ministry, RBI, MPC, SEBI, SBI
traps.fix: MPC sets repo; Govt sets target; RBI regulates banks (BR Act); SEBI regulates capital market, not money-market participant
traps.pyq: Repo fixed by 'Monetary Policy Committee' [mains-2017-paper1#113]; SEBI does not participate in organised money market [mains-2017-paper3#7]

traps.trap: [Category] Instrument placed among institutions or organised among unorganised
traps.spot: Negative 'not a part of' list mixing instruments and agents
traps.fix: Organised money market: RBI, banks, DFHI, MMMFs, T-bills, CDs; unorganised: moneylenders, indigenous bankers, finance companies
traps.pyq: Not organised money market → 'Finance companies' [mains-2017-paper3#5]; not an intermediary → 'commercial and trade bills' [mains-2017-paper3#6]

traps.fix: Malhotra–insurance; Urjit Patel–monetary framework 2014; Chakravarty–monetary system 1985; Raj–agri tax 1972; N.K. Singh–FRBM review
traps.pyq: IRDA suggested by 'Malhotra Committee' [mains-2017-paper1#111]; agricultural income tax → 'Raj Committee, 1972' [mains-2017-paper1#110]

traps.trap: [Scope] 'Only' or 'alone' restricts a wider true set
traps.fix: BoP = current + capital; inflation needs monetary + fiscal + exchange-rate mix
traps.pyq: BoP 'includes current account and capital account' [mains-2025-paper2#37]; inflation control needs a combination [mains-2017-paper3#3]

traps.spot: A-R pair where R gives the price effect
traps.fix: Devaluation makes exports cheaper and imports dearer – A true, R 'export prices rise' false
traps.pyq: 'Devaluation will lead to increase in price of exports' → R false [mains-2025-paper2#32]

traps.trap: [GST] Includes a GST-excluded item or wrong Article
traps.spot: Lists of petrol, liquor, electricity; Article 269A vs 279A
traps.fix: Outside GST: alcohol for consumption, petroleum products, electricity; Council = Art 279A (269A = IGST)
traps.pyq: No GST on petrol/diesel, liquor, electricity, charitable services → all [mains-2025-paper2#45]; Council under 269A is incorrect [mains-2025-paper2#1]

techniques.name: [Liquidity] Inject–absorb map
techniques.how: Draw the corridor: SDF floor (absorb) – repo (policy) – MSF ceiling (inject). Place each option on it.
techniques.example: Instrument to contain overnight-rate volatility → the ceiling MSF [mains-2019-paper3#40]; SDF absorbs without collateral, so 'increasing liquidity' falls [mains-2025-paper2#15]

techniques.name: [Deficits] Three-line formula sheet
techniques.how: Write RD, FD, PD formulas; read each option as one formula and tick the match.
techniques.example: 'Subtracting interest payments from fiscal deficit' → PD [mains-2019-paper3#83]

techniques.name: [BoP] Account-tree placement
techniques.how: BoT (goods) ⊂ current account (goods + services + transfers) ⊂ BoP (+ capital). Put the stem's item on its branch.
techniques.example: Q4 2023-24 current-account surplus → services exports, not merchandise [mains-2025-paper2#5]

techniques.name: [Bodies] Regulator, participant or instrument?
techniques.how: Classify each option as a body type or an instrument; in 'not a part of' questions the misfit class wins.
techniques.example: Organised money-market participants: DFHI, banks, mutual funds; SEBI is a capital-market regulator → answer [mains-2017-paper3#7]

techniques.name: [Numbers] Date-stamp the ratio
techniques.how: Rates (SLR, CRR, FD %) change; tie the figure to the review or budget named in the stem.
techniques.example: SLR 'according to the 2019 review' → 19.25, not today's 18 [prelims-2019#121]; FD 2024-25 RE 4.8% > 2025-26 BE → both true [mains-2025-paper2#12]

techniques.name: [Policy] Policy-to-instrument matching
techniques.how: Monetary → bank rate/repo; selective credit → margin; fiscal → tax rate; trade → imports/exports.
techniques.example: Monetary–iv, Trade–iii (imports and exports), Credit–ii (margin), Fiscal–i (tax rate) → a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i [mains-2025-paper2#39]

confusions.remember: Repo: RBI lends; reverse repo/SDF: RBI borrows (SDF without collateral)
MSF ceiling (repo + 25 bps, inject); SDF floor (repo – 25 bps, absorb)
Subsidies, interest, salaries = revenue; assets and loans given = capital
Core excludes volatile food & fuel; RBI targets headline CPI 4% ±2
< 1 year (T-bills, CP, CD) vs > 1 year (shares, bonds)
Gilt = government securities and those backed by a government guarantee
Direct = home currency per unit of foreign (Rs per $)
Devaluation = official cut under a fixed rate; depreciation = market fall
Arbitrage = simultaneous buy-low sell-high at two places; speculation = bet over time
TRIPS = intellectual property; TRIMS = investment measures
Blue = production-limiting; green = minimal distortion; amber = distorting
Same year; ARDC merged into NABARD
Intra = same product imported and exported

anchors: Inflation target notified Aug 2016: CPI 4% with 2–6% band; MPC sets repo
1969: 14 banks with deposits ≥ Rs 50 crore; 1980: 6 more
Re 1 note and coins issued by Government; other notes by RBI; 2016 demonetisation under RBI Act
Banking Regulation Act 1949 gives RBI its regulatory powers
FRBM Act 2003: FD 3% of GDP; no penalty clause; N.K. Singh review → FD 2.5% by 2022-23; RD target dropped 2018
GST rolled out 1 July 2017; J&K joined last; Council Art 279A
FER = Foreign Currency Assets + Gold + SDR + Reserve Tranche Position
FDI banned in chit funds; multi-brand retail 51%
IBC 2016; 2019 merger: Vijaya + Dena → Bank of Baroda
Andhra Bank founded 1923 by Bhogaraju Pattabhi Sitaramaiah
Budget time shifted to 11 a.m. in 1999
checklist: Liquidity tool? Decide inject or absorb and who lends to whom.
Deficit or budget item? Write the formula or revenue/capital split before reading options.
BoP item? Place it on the goods–services–transfers–capital tree.
Body named? Ask regulator, participant or instrument – and who holds the power.
Ratio or rate? Lock the review/budget year in the stem.
GST item? Check the excluded list and Article 279A vs 269A.
'Only/alone' option? Test whether the true set is wider.
